items.label: 🐈Double-room cat litter cabinet design
items.value: Our spacious and luxurious two-room cat litter cabinet provides ample space for two cats to comfortably use at the same time. With dimensions of 55”L x 17.7”W x 22.5”L, it can easily accommodate most cat litter boxes, ensuring a convenient and stylish solution for your cat companions.

items.label: 🐈Integrated furniture
items.value: Our double-cage cat litter cabinet serves a dual purpose, functioning not only as a cat house but also as a private and secluded cat toilet. This multi-functional piece can also be utilized as a TV cabinet, coffee table, or other decorative furniture, adding both practicality and elegance to your living space.

items.label: 🐈Intimate cat mat
items.value: Our cat litter cabinet is equipped with a high-quality cat mat in the middle, which can effectively reduce the residual litter brought by cats from the litter box, making your house tidier and cleaner and reducing odor.

items.label: 🐈Sophisticated design
items.value: Our double-cage cat litter cabinet features a carefully designed entrance hole in the middle section, allowing for easy access for your cats while promoting proper ventilation and lighting within the interior space. Additionally, the cabinet is constructed with waterproof materials, making it effortless to clean and maintain.

items.label: 🐈Convenient storage
items.value: We understand the importance of organization. That's why our cat litter cabinet incorporates a groove in the middle section, serving as a storage compartment for canned cat food and other supplies. This practical design element not only maximizes storage space but also promotes a tidy and orderly environment.
